rules.statement: Conditional transfers are not subject to the principles of laesio enormis.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) Conditional transfers do not come within the exception to the principles of laesio enormis. (ii) A conditional transfer cannot be read to be in the nature of a specs nor is the value of the thing sold or consideration paid not capable of defi�nite estimate. (iii) Where the principle of laesio enormis does apply the right of election as to restoring the thing or paying what is wanting to make up the just price is with the plaintiff respondent (transferee). (iv) In the instant case the plaintiff-respondent has failed to exercise this right of election; however it is not justifiable to deny that right - at this stage
